integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible symbolic/exact-rational and numerical checks; no claim of peer review or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact critical boundary 4q=p(2-epsilon)^2 with 0<epsilon<1; initial laws have an exponential moment beyond 2/(2-epsilon). No uniform endpoint estimates, off-critical crossover, or heavy-tail classification. An earlier doctoral thesis was inaccessible and historical priority is provisional.
title: Critical survival amplitudes for the open Pelikan random map
